correctness.rationale: For all m>=3, the published integer-facet criterion reduces hub-anchored dual extreme potentials to valid signed path words. Conditional sign independence between different runs cancels cross-run products, leaving exactly 2 b_(i-1) b_(m-j) signed words for every i<=j. The recurrence for b is proved by the three possible suffixes before a fixed sign; Z_m=2(b_(m-1)+b_(m-2)). The Green matrix has positive adjacent determinants and an explicitly checked tridiagonal inverse. The cubic generating function gives the claimed bulk exponential rate; its non-Perron roots have modulus <1. Independent exact graph traversal and rational inversion passed for m=2,...,9. The finite checks are corroborative, not a substitute for the infinite proof.
